differs: Final legacy builds carry Roo PR #8954, so tokensIn includes both caches (kilo-code.md §4): kilo-task-1 40 -> 30, …808 1000 -> 800. tokscale and TokenTracker read tokensIn as uncached. TokenTracker also counts api_req_deleted (500/25/100) for a total of 1875; we skip it because an incremental reader already counted the removed rows, so our …808 total is 800+200+50 = 1050. Neither our adapter nor TokenTracker reads the model (tokscale: <model> tag gpt-5); the cost 0 row is priced from the table. The placeholder counts once when back-filled (step 2: +900/100).
